Redistribution requires preserving the license/copyright notices and imposing downstream compliance. Separate written licensing is required above the agreement's MAU/revenue thresholds. Voice cloning/commercial voice use also requires explicit rights from the voice owner. Keep optional until customer terms and notice flow are implemented.

Replace with BossAI-owned licensed voice assets or require customer-supplied authorized reference audio.
